editorial_policy.scope: All generated references reviewed; corrections apply by sourced relationships, never by case ID
editorial_policy.paragraph: One compact paragraph; three sentences normally; fourth for indispensable distinction
editorial_policy.reflection: One mobilizing question only when it adds a sourced reflection; direct or indirect; not mandatory, no new answer request
avoid: repeated wording with no new distinction
wish for freedom converted to achieved freedom
editorial_policy.state_preservation: A stated wish cannot erase reported disconnection/uncertainty from P01; keep both without manufacturing a causal explanation.

fallback_evaluation: R_BOUNDED_PRESENT is evaluated only after all specific rules, regardless of stable_order.

option_treatment_policy.scope: All selected P01-P33 canonical option IDs; omitted/not_shown remain record states, free text remains literal

context_history_only.use: Retain structured context/history in the Object; no automatic causal claim, no replacing the present whole-map reading with a history-only paragraph

literal_elicitation_only.use: Preserve exact text and branch activation; no automatic content claim, no inferred value, wish, resource or diagnosis

option_treatment_policy.local_states: P22 nothing/not considered, P33 none/not considered and P29 No do not become positive resources or generalized uncertainty
option_treatment_policy.exploration: P28 forms remain distinct from general interest. A rejection of the offered forms never erases P01/P24 interest.
option_treatment_policy.coverage_claim: Explicit treatment of every option is not exhaustive material-crossing or voice validation

title_contract.validation: Closed wording plus independently checked factual eligibility; not open prose title generation.
